text:
sarah: Heads-up — noticed console per-route charts under-report tokens when requests fall back to smaller variants. Ex: route /chat/encoder shows 90% using model-x, but billing shows more tokens.

kevin: Hmm. Are fallbacks being attributed to original route or to the variant?

anika: Right now telemetry logs `model_served`=variant_id but the console groups by route+model mapping from route config. If we don't include routing_decision metadata in the route-level aggregate, counts get split and the per-route view looks wrong.

kevin: Can we add a toggle in the Route view — `include fallbacks`? Quick UI win to surface the combined numbers.

sarah: Yes, but we need server-side consistency for sampled traces. If sampling drops routing metadata, the toggle will be misleading.

devops-bot: ci/telemetry-service build failed on branch `feature/routing-meta` — 6 failing tests. :construction:

anika: Proposed telemetry payload (needs review):
```
{
  "request_id": "<uuid>",
  "route": "/chat/encoder",
  "chosen_model": "open-llama-13b",
  "routing_reason": "fallback_capacity",
  "parent_model": "gpt-4-like-xxl",
  "tokens": 120
}
```

product-mike: UX idea: show a compact "routing breakdown" pill next to the model selector. 3 bars: primary, fallback, region-failover. Clicking a bar opens a saved query for the last 24h filtered by `routing_reason`. That makes root-cause for cost spikes discoverable. :bulb:

kevin: Also need quota math in the console: fallbacks still consume quota from the route owner. Surface projected spend if fallback rate > 5% or > X tokens.

sarah: Agree. For rollout UX, when we canary and the canary ends up triggering fallbacks, we should auto-create a lightweight saved query named `rollout:<route>/fallbacks` and pin it to the deployment UI so SREs can monitor immediately.

anika: Implementation notes: add `routing_reason` enum, keep `chosen_model` string. For now keep `fallback_chain` as a comma-separated string (avoid nested arrays in telemetry blob so ingestion stays simple). Also include `sample_rate` in every event header.

kevin: +1. This is a breaking telemetry contract change — bump to telemetry API v2, add changelog and migration guide for downstream consumers.

product-mike: I'll mock the tiny UI toggle and the pill, and add acceptance criteria to the rollout checklist. Can we land the server schema and a lightweight UI toggle in the next sprint?

sarah: Sounds good — I'll follow up with the PR link when tests are green. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
